integrity: Exact exhaustive finite-state search with self-contained verification code and 100-class table. Equality at every length follows from complete synchronized deterministic relation-automaton reachability, not extrapolation of a finite prefix. The proof and computational certificate were reviewed only within this study.
scientific_limitations: One-step indexed binary cyclic rings only; not multistep, nonperiodic images, necklace quotients, or more general local rules; independent literature priority is not guaranteed.
title: A sharp eight-cell test for equality of cyclic image languages of elementary cellular automata
